coachNPulse.title: Coach'n Pulse
coachNPulse.subtitle: The website of a triathlon and endurance sports coach in Grenoble, which we have kept running since 2016.

cta.title: Discover Coach'n Pulse
cta.description: Programmes, the coach's background and prices: it is all on the Coach'n Pulse website.
cta.ariaLabel: Visit the Coach'n Pulse website (opens in a new tab)

for_whom.label: Who it's for
for_whom.title: An endurance sports coach in Grenoble
for_whom.description: Luc Nahon is a state-certified triathlon instructor, coach and mental trainer. He works with people getting back into sport as well as athletes preparing for an Ironman. He needed a website to present what he offers and make people want to get in touch.

what_we_did.label: What we did
what_we_did.title: A clear website for the offer and the coach
what_we_did.description: We designed a website of a few pages that answers a future athlete's questions: what is on offer, who the coach is and how much it costs.

items.programs: Personalised programmes and assessments, by goal (health, weight loss, competition…) and by discipline
items.coach: The coach's background, qualifications and experience
items.contact: His contact details close at hand, on a computer or a phone

result.label: Result
result.title: A website looked after for ten years
result.description: Online since 2016, the website has been rebuilt and updated as web tools evolved. This long-term care is what we offer every one of our clients.
result.maintained: Version {version} came out in {date}, with a new design.

mcomperat.title: mcomper.at
mcomperat.subtitle: Matthieu Compérat's online résumé, and the testing ground for the tools we then use for our clients.

cta.title: Discover mcomper.at
cta.description: Browse Matthieu Compérat's online résumé, in French or English.
cta.ariaLabel: Visit the mcomper.at website (opens in a new tab)

for_whom.label: Who it's for
for_whom.title: An online résumé
for_whom.description: mcomper.at is the online résumé of Matthieu Compérat, your contact at Cosmic Studio. His background and skills fit on a single page.

what_we_did.label: What we did
what_we_did.title: A clear, fast résumé in two languages
what_we_did.description: We built a site that is easy to read and easy to update.

items.two_languages: Available in French and English, with texts written for each language
items.found_on_google: Pages prepared to be found on Google
items.fast_on_phone: Pages that load quickly and are easy to read on a phone
items.ai_with_review: AI as an assistant for writing and translating, with every text reviewed by a person

result.label: Result
result.title: Tested here, then used for you
result.description: Matthieu has a clear, bilingual and fast online résumé. It is where we worked out how to handle several languages, how pages appear on Google and how to review texts drafted with AI, before using all of this on our clients' sites. Every change also goes through automatic checks, to catch mistakes.

choeurDesPaysduMontBlanc.title: Chœur des Pays du Mont Blanc
choeurDesPaysduMontBlanc.subtitle: A website mockup proposed to an amateur choir in Haute-Savoie, with its concerts, repertoire and rehearsals.

cta.title: Discover the mockup
cta.description: Upcoming concerts, repertoire, rehearsals: browse the mockup as we proposed it to the choir.
cta.ariaLabel: View the Chœur des Pays du Mont Blanc website mockup (opens in a new tab)

for_whom.label: Who it's for
for_whom.title: An amateur choir in Haute-Savoie
for_whom.description: The Chœur des Pays du Mont Blanc is an association of amateur singers in Haute-Savoie. We proposed a site that would serve its members as much as people who do not know it yet.

what_we_did.label: What we did
what_we_did.title: A mockup for singers and the public
what_we_did.description: We brought together everything singers, music lovers and the general public look for in a single mockup, easy to read on a computer or a phone.

items.concerts: A concert calendar with dates, venues and programmes
items.repertoire: A look at the repertoire, from baroque to contemporary classical music
items.join: Rehearsal times and how to join the choir
items.news: News and events from the life of the choir

result.label: Result
result.title: A proposal made to the choir
result.description: The mockup shows what the choir's website could look like. It has been proposed to the association and is not, to date, its official website.
